capabilities: Read @settings blocks from themes, snippets and plugin styles
Render a settings panel with all Style Settings setting types
Import saved values from Style Settings data
Reset individual settings or whole sections
Export and import values as JSON (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a CSS editor or theme designer; it only reads existing @settings blocks and never writes to a CSS file.
extras: Free core features; Pro (presets, JSON import/export, gradients, search, undo) requires a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) and GitHub sign-in. Conflicts with Style Settings, Style Manager or Style Tuner: it applies nothing while those are enabled. The conflict check uses an undocumented part of Obsidian and may silently stop working after an update. No network requests until Pro sign-in; no telemetry.
intentEvidence: The saved data has the same layout as the data of Style Settings.
problem: Theme and snippet settings blocks in CSS have no built-in UI, so users must edit CSS or rely on a single third-party plugin to change them.
